note: Seats staffed from the SLIM (example-free) agent descriptions in variants/agents/ for the 6 varied roles; plugins/mochiko/agents/ descriptions for the rest. Skill bodies + skill descriptions all originals. from_description_only=true means the routing decision used only the agent frontmatter description (no body).

staffing_decisions.route_basis: PM description: 'owns the product's capability layer … stewarding the living feature map as a source of truth'. The intent-stage map read is feature-map work; RA elicits, PA is governance — neither owns the map.

The command frames the intent stage as lead-run ('run the adaptive-probe agenda via mochiko:analysis-iterative'); analysis-iterative is a general/shared skill not on any roster agent's skills list. requirements-analyst ('eliciting requirements through structured discovery') was the strongest agent candidate and is noted, but elicitation-facilitation stayed lead-owned per the harness.
RA description: 'producing clear user stories with measurable acceptance criteria'. PM owns which capabilities, not how stories are written.
PE description: 'clickable low-fidelity prototypes that render user stories as screens and walkable flows, honoring an existing design system'. Exact match; unique fit.
RA 'authors the specification'. technical-analyst is plan-time TR/data-model/contracts — business FR/SC belongs to RA at specify time.

PM description: 'deriving durable features from user stories … filtering stories that don't earn a place on the map … advising which capabilities align with the product need now. Recommends … selection is always the user's ruling'. Exact match.
Reserved to the user by the command ('the feature selection'). PM recommends, user rules.

staffing_decisions.seat_moment: Adversarial spec review (spec + stories + derivation + map delta + prototype walk)
staffing_decisions.route_basis: DA description: 'stress-tests specifications by finding gaps … severity-ranked gap report … recommended verdict'. validator's only skill is validation-constitution (governance-scoped, not specs); principal-architect's review lane is cross-artifact feasibility of plan artifacts, not spec gaps. DA is the spec grader.

staffing_decisions.seat_moment: Disposition / clearing of the gap report
staffing_decisions.route_basis: review-specifications states the clearing decision is the lead's; the command reserves the loop to the lead. principal-architect considered but its skills don't cover spec-review disposition; not staffed.
Reserved to the user by the command; acceptance executes the map write.

staffing_decisions.seat_moment: Acceptance-time map write batch + KM landing
staffing_decisions.route_basis: PM owns authoring-feature-map; the write executes at acceptance per the skill's write rules. Spec-index stewardship rides the same skill.

roster_not_staffed.validator: Its only skill is validation-constitution (governance-scoped). Spec grading is devils-advocate via review-specifications. Correct route, not a miss.
roster_not_staffed.principal-architect: Its skills (authoring-constitution, analysis-codebase, review-feasibility, authoring-architecture) are not exercised at specify time; disposition is lead-owned. Correct, not a miss.
roster_not_staffed.technical-analyst / system-architect / s: Plan-time and implement-time seats, not specify. Not applicable this command.

primary_measurement: specify staffed 4 of the varied roster — requirements-analyst, product-manager, product-engineer, devils-advocate — the four named 'at minimum'. Setup (per the arm design) staffed principal-architect + validator + devils-advocate, i.e. of the varied set only devils-advocate. specify therefore staffs strictly MORE of the varied roster than setup (+requirements-analyst, +product-manager, +product-engineer). PASS.

Derivation + filter + selection card + acceptance-time write
